items.heading: Students Keep Asking Questions Like
items.text: Students Keep Asking Questions Like Students Keep Asking Questions Like Students keep asking questions like "I got a rank of 20,000, which course is best?", "can BiPC students get BSc Agriculture with a 30,000 rank?" and "do I need NEET for nursing in Telangana?" Most answers online are undated. This table is dated 30 September 2026 and shows where each door stands right now.

items.heading: Farmers Quota Needs Land Farmers
items.text: Farmers Quota Needs Land Farmers quota needs land and school records. Agriculture counselling reports a 40 percent farmers quota that asks for land proof and a rural school certificate. Check the current notification for the exact forms.

items.heading: Veterinary Is Often Filed Under
items.text: Veterinary is often filed under "needs NEET". That is only partly true, and the split shows up in the seat type.

rows: AP BiPC counselling (B.Pharm, Pharm.D, biotech, food, pharmaceutical engineering)
Final phase seats were allotted on 23 September and reporting ran 24 to 26 September. One portal reports about 516 seats still vacant across 239 colleges.
Ask colleges directly about vacant seats and whether fee reimbursement applies to spot admissions. Do not assume it does.
Final phase: web options 25 to 27 September, allotment 29 September, college reporting 30 September to 1 October.
If your allotment came today, complete self-reporting and college reporting inside the window. A missed date can cancel the seat.
ANGRAU agriculture and food technology (AP EAPCET rank)
Phase I web options ran 24 to 26 September. The university shows a later application window that closes 29 September.
Check the ANGRAU admissions page tonight for the next dated step, and keep local-status and farmers-quota papers ready.
Telangana BSc Nursing (TG EAPCET rank, KNRUHS)
Registration ran 16 to 24 September and was extended to 27 September. It has closed.
If you registered, watch the KNRUHS site for the merit list and seat numbers, which the prospectus says will be notified before web options.

items.heading: Ask for the Total Fee
items.text: Ask for the total fee across all years. Tuition, hostel, exam, internship and uniform. Compare it with a realistic first pay rather than with the fee of the next college.

items.heading: Keep a Second Seat Alive
items.text: Keep a second seat alive. Register in a second counselling path so one missed date does not cost the year. That is planning, not a lack of faith.

figures.label: Seats More 1
figures.source: No entrance step and no rank pressure, which is exactly why the outcome depends on what you add. A student who pairs the degree with data handling, lab method and one published piece of work can sell the skill across employers and remotely. OAMDC lists about 4.9 lakh seats in more than 1,300 colleges and Telangana DOST about 4.2 lakh in 978-plus colleges, across all streams, so seats are never the limit.

figures.label: Pay Range
figures.source: The most seat-rich door: 10,958 B.Pharm seats in AP phase 1 alone and 8,473 in Telangana. Pay starts modestly. AmbitionBox lists pharmacists at Rs 1.2 to 4.1 lakh a year from 23,200 salary reports (July 2025), with freshers at Rs 1 to 4 lakh. Quality assurance, regulatory work, clinical research and an owned pharmacy are where pay separates.

figures.label: Rs 1
figures.source: A government ladder and a private agri-business ladder. The APPSC Horticulture Officer notice lists 37 posts at Rs 54,060 to Rs 1,40,540 a month and asks for a four-year BSc (Hons) in Horticulture. That is a small number of posts against roughly 263 horticulture seats a year in Andhra Pradesh as reported, so the government post is a bonus and not a plan.
